name: Advanced College Football Composite (ACFC) Top 25 Ranking Engine
description: v0.4.0 verification release: every 2026 game result cross-checked against ESPN (53/53 correct) and both published polls verified against AP/USA Today. Fixed seven teams' false Top-25 wins and restored Ole Miss's real one; removed Boise State's fabricated AP #26 / Coaches #24 and Louisville's out-of-range Coaches #26; normalised all opponent rank tags to the kickoff snapshot; corrected Virginia's week-0 game; made projectedSosRank a strict permutation; renamed the mislabelled colleyMetric to meritIndex and added a genuine runtime Colley solve. The UI now renders every weight claim from engine.getEffectiveWeights() so documented and implemented weights cannot diverge again, the matchup engine's spread/score/win-probability are mutually consistent, the Top 25 is exactly 25 rows with a First Team Out strip, KPI cards 2-4 are computed instead of hard-coded, and audit/verify.js runs on every push.

versioningProtocol.minor: +0.1: Algorithmic weight tweaks, UI styling refinements, roster/schedule adjustments, heuristic updates
versioningProtocol.major: +1.0: New ranking data models, backend API integration, multi-season archives, or architectural changes
